car_questions.question: Vehicles transporting dangerous goods on a freeway or expressway should drive in:
options: (1) The inner lane.
(2) The outer lane.
(3) Either lane. And lane changing is prohibited.

car_questions.question: When a vehicle is traveling at high speed, the lower the cargo's center of gravity, its stability is:
options: (1) Better.
(2) Worse.
(3) Unaffected.

car_questions.topic: Accident Prevention & Handling (Secondary Highway Accidents, First Aid)
car_questions.question: Regarding vehicle loading regulations, which is correct?
options: (1) Passengers may be carried outside the vehicle cabin.
(2) A trailer attached to a small vehicle may carry any item.
(3) The front cab of a truck or the front seat of a small vehicle must not carry more passengers than the approved number.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) The front cab of a truck or the front seat of a small vehicle must not carry more passengers than the approved number..

options: (1) Vehicle width restriction.

car_questions.question: What does this road sign indicate?
options: (1) Prescribed direction.
(2) First-aid station.
(3) Fork road.

car_questions.topic: Accident Prevention & Handling (Secondary Highway Accidents, First Aid)
car_questions.question: When a vehicle breaks down or encounters another emergency on a national freeway and cannot continue driving, if the vehicle cannot coast off the lane, in addition to activating the hazard warning lights, how many meters behind the vehicle should a breakdown warning sign be placed to prevent secondary accidents?
options: (1) 30 to 50 meters.
(2) 50 to 100 meters.
(3) 100 meters or more.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) 100 meters or more..

car_questions.topic: Accident Prevention & Handling (Secondary Highway Accidents, First Aid)
car_questions.question: When a minor collision (no casualties) occurs on a national freeway, which of the following actions by the parties involved is correct?
options: (1) To allow investigation personnel to gather evidence, the scene should be preserved until police arrive before anything is moved.
(2) After taking photos and videos, the vehicle should be moved to a safe location as soon as possible.
(3) Place a breakdown warning sign in the lane and wait for police to arrive and handle the situation.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) After taking photos and videos, the vehicle should be moved to a safe location as soon as possible..

car_questions.topic: Accident Prevention & Handling (Secondary Highway Accidents, First Aid)
car_questions.question: When a road traffic accident occurs, a breakdown warning sign or other clearly visible warning device must be placed behind the vehicle as required. Which of the following distances is correct?
options: (1) On an expressway, 70 meters behind the accident site.
(2) On a freeway, 100 meters behind the accident site.
(3) On a road section with a maximum speed limit of 50 km/h or below, 20 meters behind the accident site.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) On a freeway, 100 meters behind the accident site..

car_questions.question: While driving on a national freeway, your vehicle suddenly breaks down and stops in the lane. After turning on the hazard lights and securing the vehicle, approximately how many meters behind the vehicle should you place a breakdown warning sign (triangle) to comply with regulations and effectively alert following vehicles?
options: (1) 30 to 50 meters.
(2) 500 meters or more.
(3) 100 meters or more.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) 100 meters or more..

car_questions.question: When a motor vehicle driver is driving a passenger car on the main lanes of a freeway and wishes to change lanes to overtake, which of the following practices best reflects the principles of 'safety guidelines' and 'defensive driving'?
options: (1) As long as you see that the vehicle behind still has some distance, even if it flashes its lights as a warning, you should accelerate and cut in to complete the overtake.
(2) After completing the overtake, you should immediately cut back to the original lane without deliberately maintaining a safe distance from the overtaken vehicle.

(3) Before changing lanes, pay attention to the traffic conditions in the target lane, confirm a safe distance before merging; if the vehicle behind flashes its lights as a warning, you should temporarily hold off on changing lanes.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Before changing lanes, pay attention to the traffic conditions in the target lane, confirm a safe distance before merging; if the vehicle behind flashes its lights as a warning, you should temporarily hold off on changing lanes..

car_questions.question: Regarding 'shoulder use' and 'breakdown response' on highways, which of the following situations is handled correctly and can effectively prevent secondary accidents?
options: (1) To save time, if the main lane ahead is congested, you may temporarily drive on the shoulder to keep traffic flowing.

(2) If a vehicle breaks down while driving, you should slowly move to the shoulder and stop, place a breakdown warning sign 50~100 meters behind the vehicle, and personnel should wait outside the guardrail for rescue.
(3) After an accident, to protect the vehicle and property, all passengers should remain inside the vehicle with the doors locked until the tow truck arrives.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) If a vehicle breaks down while driving, you should slowly move to the shoulder and stop, place a breakdown warning sign 50~100 meters behind the vehicle, and personnel should wait outside the guardrail for rescue..

car_questions.question: After a traffic accident, what is the main purpose of placing a 'vehicle breakdown warning sign'?
options: (1) To warn vehicles coming from behind and prevent the police from issuing a ticket
(2) To warn vehicles coming from behind and prevent a secondary rear-end collision
(3) To serve as a reference point for calculating vehicle damage during an insurance claim
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) To warn vehicles coming from behind and prevent a secondary rear-end collision.

car_questions.question: Regarding correct habits for nighttime driving and waiting at intersections, which of the following practices can effectively improve safety and prevent accidents?
options: (1) When passing through a tunnel, since there is lighting inside, it is not necessarily required to turn on headlights.
(2) When waiting at a red light at an intersection at night, as long as you are not the first vehicle, you may turn off your headlights to save power.
(3) When waiting at a red light at night, you should keep your headlights on and pay attention to the movements of surrounding pedestrians and vehicles at all times.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) When waiting at a red light at night, you should keep your headlights on and pay attention to the movements of surrounding pedestrians and vehicles at all times..

car_questions.question: If a driver is involved in a traffic accident with no casualties and the vehicle is still drivable, how should the driver initially handle the situation to prevent secondary accidents?
options: (1) The vehicle's position and point of impact should first be marked or photographed/recorded, and then the vehicle should be moved to the roadside.
(2) Stay at the scene and wait for the police to arrive; the vehicle must not be moved.
(3) Leave the scene directly and report to the police afterward.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) The vehicle's position and point of impact should first be marked or photographed/recorded, and then the vehicle should be moved to the roadside..

car_questions.question: After a vehicle is involved in an accident, to prevent secondary accidents, what measure should be taken first?
options: (1) Move the vehicle immediately.
(2) Turn on hazard warning lights and set up warning signs.
(3) Turn off all lights.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Turn on hazard warning lights and set up warning signs..

car_questions.question: A car driver wants to take a long trip. Before departure, to implement a self-inspection for 'accident prevention and handling,' which of the following practices best reflects the safety concept of 'prevention is better than cure'?
options: (1) As long as the tires don't look flat, the tire pressure is fine; tread depth or cracks do not significantly affect driving safety.
(2) After taking medication while ill, if you feel mentally acceptable, you should insist on driving to keep to the schedule, and just drink more coffee along the way to stay alert.

(3) Inspect the vehicle condition (including the five fluids (fuel, engine oil, power steering fluid, transmission fluid, brake fluid), three waters (coolant, battery fluid, washer fluid), six lights (headlights, parking lights, turn signals, fog lights, brake lights, reverse lights), tread depth and tire pressure), and if you did not sleep enough the night before, rest first or ask someone else to drive.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Inspect the vehicle condition (including the five fluids (fuel, engine oil, power steering fluid, transmission fluid, brake fluid), three waters (coolant, battery fluid, washer fluid), six lights (headlights, parking lights, turn signals, fog lights, brake lights, reverse lights), tread depth and tire pressure), and if you did not sleep enough the night before, rest first or ask someone else to drive..

car_questions.question: When driving inside a tunnel on a freeway or expressway and you cannot continue driving due to an emergency, you should first stop and wait for assistance. At how many meters behind the broken-down vehicle should you place the vehicle breakdown warning sign?
options: (1) 10 meters.
(2) 50 meters.
(3) 100 meters.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) 100 meters..

car_questions.question: When a driver is traveling on a freeway or expressway and cannot continue driving due to vehicle breakdown or other emergency, which of the following responses is INCORRECT?
options: (1) The vehicle should be coasted off the main lane and parked on the shoulder to wait for rescue.
(2) While waiting for rescue, hazard warning lights should be turned on and a breakdown warning sign should be placed behind the vehicle.
(3) A broken-down vehicle parked on the shoulder must not remain there for more than 4 hours.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) A broken-down vehicle parked on the shoulder must not remain there for more | Year 115 Edition than 4 hours..

car_questions.question: After a traffic accident occurs, what is the main purpose of placing a warning sign to the rear?
options: (1) To speed up traffic flow.
(2) To prevent secondary accidents.
(3) To reduce liability.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) To prevent secondary accidents..

car_questions.question: If a traffic accident occurs on the road resulting in injuries, and both vehicles cannot be moved, which of the following should be done first?
options: (1) Call the police first; there is no need to get out of the vehicle.
(2) Place a vehicle breakdown warning sign at an appropriate distance behind the disabled vehicles.
(3) Get out of the vehicle and stand in the center of the traffic lane to direct traffic.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Place a vehicle breakdown warning sign at an appropriate distance behind the disabled vehicles..

car_questions.question: After a traffic accident occurs, what should be done first?
options: (1) Call the police immediately.
(2) To avoid disrupting traffic, move the vehicle right away.
(3) Stop the vehicle, turn on hazard lights, and place a warning triangle behind the vehicle.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Stop the vehicle, turn on hazard lights, and place a warning triangle behind the vehicle..

car_questions.question: To prevent traffic accidents, the most important practice while driving is:
options: (1) Maintain a safe following distance.
(2) Exceed the speed limit to reach the destination faster.
(3) Pay attention only to the vehicle ahead.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Maintain a safe following distance..

car_questions.question: When a vehicle breaks down or is involved in an accident and stops on the road at night, how should you warn vehicles coming from behind?
options: (1) Stand behind the vehicle and wave both hands.
(2) Only turn on the interior light.
(3) Turn on hazard warning lights and set up warning signs.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Turn on hazard warning lights and set up warning signs..

car_questions.question: When a traffic accident or vehicle breakdown occurs on a freeway and you need to report and request assistance through the dedicated customer service system, which hotline should you call?
options: (1) 1968 APP (police reporting).
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) 1968 APP (police reporting)..

car_questions.question: When a driver causes a traffic accident with no injuries or fatalities and the vehicle is still drivable, which of the following procedures is correct?
options: (1) Mark the vehicle's position and photograph relevant evidence first, then move the vehicle to a location that does not obstruct traffic.
(2) Do not move the vehicle; wait at the scene for police to arrive in order to preserve the original evidence.
(3) Only need to reach a verbal agreement with the other party and then both may leave the scene.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Mark the vehicle's position and photograph relevant evidence first, then move the vehicle to a location that does not obstruct traffic..

car_questions.question: When driving on a freeway or expressway and encountering a traffic jam caused by an accident or other reasons, which of the following measures is INCORRECT?
options: (1) Obey the directions of traffic police officers on duty; vehicles must not be temporarily stopped or parked on the shoulder.
(2) Move the vehicle to the shoulder based on the situation at the scene.
(3) Vehicles stopped in the main lane should activate hazard warning lights.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Move the vehicle to the shoulder based on the situation at the scene..

car_questions.question: If a vehicle becomes stranded inside a long tunnel, how should the situation be handled to maintain air quality in the tunnel?
options: (1) Turn on the strong-wind air conditioning.
(2) Open the windows for ventilation.
(3) Temporarily turn off the engine.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Temporarily turn off the engine..

car_questions.question: When a road traffic accident occurs but there are no casualties and the vehicles can still be driven, how should it be handled?
options: (1) Do not move the accident vehicles or any physical evidence at the scene arbitrarily; wait for the police to arrive and handle the matter.
(2) First mark or photograph/record the positions of the vehicles and the point of impact, then move the vehicles to a location that does not obstruct traffic.
(3) Move the vehicles directly to the road shoulder and park, then set up a vehicle breakdown sign at an appropriate distance.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) First mark or photograph/record the positions of the vehicles and the point of impact, then move the vehicles to a location that does not obstruct traffic..

car_questions.question: On which type of road section, when a vehicle breaks down and cannot be moved to a location that does not obstruct traffic, must a vehicle breakdown sign be placed on the road surface 5 to 30 meters behind the vehicle?
options: (1) Freeways and expressways.
(2) Non-freeway/expressway road sections where the driving speed exceeds 40 km/h.
(3) Road sections where the driving speed is 40 km/h or below.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Road sections where the driving speed is 40 km/h or below..

car_questions.question: At an accident scene when an unconscious injured person is present, which of the following actions is IMPROPER?
options: (1) Stay calm and avoid moving the injured person arbitrarily.
(2) Notify the fire department as quickly as possible.
(3) Slap or shake the injured person in an attempt to restore consciousness.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Slap or shake the injured person in an attempt to restore consciousness..

car_questions.question: When automatically issuing citations for speeding vehicles, the violation locations must be at least:
options: (1) 14 km apart.
(2) 8 km apart.
(3) 6 km apart, for consecutive citations to be issued; however, this restriction does not apply if the violation occurs inside a tunnel.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) 6 km apart, for consecutive citations to be issued; however, this restriction does not apply if the violation occurs inside a tunnel..

car_questions.question: What is the following symbol?
options: (1) Engine malfunction warning light.
(2) Low oil pressure warning light.
(3) Low fuel level warning light.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Engine malfunction warning light..

car_questions.question: What does this road sign indicate?
options: (1) Passing place (refuge bay).
(2) Lane separation.
(3) Narrow road.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Passing place (refuge bay)..

car_questions.question: When a vehicle breaks down and cannot be driven on a road section with a speed limit exceeding 40 km/h, what should be done?
options: (1) Simply turn on the hazard warning lights.
(2) Place a vehicle breakdown warning sign on the road 30–100 meters behind the vehicle.
(3) Leave the vehicle in place and depart immediately.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Place a vehicle breakdown warning sign on the road 30–100 meters behind the vehicle..

car_questions.question: When driving on a freeway and encountering traffic congestion ahead, is it permissible to use the shoulder to drive? Which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) The shoulder may be used for driving.
(2) The shoulder must not be used for driving without authorization.
(3) The shoulder may be used if no traffic enforcement officers are seen.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The shoulder must not be used for driving without authorization..

car_questions.question: When a motor vehicle is involved in a traffic accident on a freeway resulting in injury or death, which of the following is correct?
options: (1) The vehicle should be immediately moved to the shoulder to avoid disrupting traffic.

(2) Rescue measures should be taken first and the police reported, and the vehicle and scene evidence must not be moved arbitrarily; however, if someone is injured and the parties involved agree, the positions must first be marked or photographed before moving the vehicle.
(3) Leave the scene first and report to the police afterward.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Rescue measures should be taken first and the police reported, and the vehicle and scene evidence must not be moved arbitrarily; however, if someone is injured and the parties involved agree, the positions must first be marked or photographed before moving the vehicle..

car_questions.question: When a motor vehicle driver is involved in a traffic accident with no injuries or fatalities, which of the following is correct?
options: (1) It is sufficient to resolve the matter privately; leaving the scene without reporting to the police is not subject to penalty.
(2) The situation must be handled according to regulations; those who flee the scene shall be fined and have their driver's license suspended.
(3) Since there are no casualties, the driver may leave the scene immediately without any further action required.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The situation must be handled according to regulations; those who flee the scene shall be fined and have their driver's license suspended..

car_questions.question: When a motor vehicle driver is involved in an accident while driving and there are injured persons, which of the following actions is correct?
options: (1) Directly send the injured to a hospital and quickly drive away from the scene.
(2) Preserve the scene, place a breakdown warning sign behind the vehicle, and report to the relevant authorities by the fastest means available.
(3) After calling the police by phone, the driver may leave the scene.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Preserve the scene, place a breakdown warning sign behind the vehicle, and report to the relevant authorities by the fastest means available..

car_questions.question: When a gasoline fire occurs, which of the following handling methods is correct?
options: (1) Large amounts of water should be directly splashed onto the fire to quickly reduce the flames.
(2) Use a fire extinguisher, sand, or cover the fire source with a wet blanket or clothing to smother it.
(3) The burning material should be moved first, then use wind to weaken the flames.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Use a fire extinguisher, sand, or cover the fire source with a wet blanket or clothing to smother it..

car_questions.question: If a party involved in a traffic accident is dissatisfied with the ruling of the 'Vehicle Accident Appraisal Committee,' within how many days from the day after receiving the appraisal liability opinion letter may they apply to the review board for reconsideration?
options: (1) Within 10 days.
(2) Within 15 days.
(3) Within 30 days.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Within 30 days..

car_questions.question: When a road traffic accident occurs and the driver or person involved is at the accident scene located in a lane or on the shoulder, how should initial measures be taken?
options: (1) Stay at the scene without taking any action until police arrive.
(2) Set up vehicle breakdown signs or other warning devices at an appropriate distance; if there are injured persons, provide prompt rescue and notify the fire department.
(3) Only need to get out of the vehicle to direct traffic; no warning devices need to be placed.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Set up vehicle breakdown signs or other warning devices at an appropriate distance; if there are injured persons, provide prompt rescue and notify the fire department..

car_questions.question: While driving, if you witness a traffic accident, you should:
options: (1) Leave the scene as quickly as possible.
(2) Stay at the scene to assist with rescue and provide testimony.
(3) Falsely claim you saw nothing if questioned.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Stay at the scene to assist with rescue and provide testimony..

car_questions.question: While driving, if you discover the brakes have failed:
options: (1) Immediately downshift, turn on the right turn signal, and prepare to pull over.
(2) Immediately pull over to the roadside.
(3) Turn on headlights and honk to alert vehicles and pedestrians ahead.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Immediately downshift, turn on the right turn signal, and prepare to pull over..

car_questions.question: If the brakes or steering fail before departure:
options: (1) Slow down and proceed.
(2) Drive as usual.
(3) Stop driving and have the vehicle repaired.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Stop driving and have the vehicle repaired. | Year 115 Edition.

car_questions.question: When a fire occurs inside a long tunnel, you should stop the engine and:
options: (1) Stay inside the vehicle with windows closed and wait for rescue.
(2) Lock the doors and evacuate.
(3) All persons evacuate, leave windows half open, leave the keys in the vehicle, and do not lock the doors.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) All persons evacuate, leave windows half open, leave the keys in the vehicle, and do not lock the doors..

car_questions.question: When a fire occurs ahead in a long tunnel, the evacuation principle is:
options: (1) Stay in the vehicle and wait for rescue.
(2) Evacuate in the opposite direction of traffic.
(3) Evacuate in the direction of traffic.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Evacuate in the opposite direction of traffic..

car_questions.question: The vehicular cross-passage in a long tunnel is:
options: (1) For parking disabled vehicles.
(2) For vehicle passage only when authorized in emergencies.
(3) For general vehicle U-turns.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) For vehicle passage only when authorized in emergencies..

car_questions.question: In a tunnel fire, to reduce harm from black smoke, how should you evacuate?
options: (1) Stay low and evacuate in the opposite direction of traffic.
(2) Stay low and evacuate in the direction of traffic.
(3) Move quickly in the direction of traffic.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Stay low and evacuate in the opposite direction of traffic..

car_questions.question: On a road with a speed limit of 40 km/h, if a vehicle breaks down and cannot be moved:
options: (1) Place a warning triangle 5–30 meters behind the vehicle.
(2) Turn on all lights and honk continuously.
(3) Just display front and rear lights.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Place a warning triangle 5–30 meters behind the vehicle..

car_questions.question: A motor vehicle driver:
options: (1) May drive continuously for 10 hours.
(2) Must not drive continuously for more than 8 hours.
(3) May decide based on physical condition.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Must not drive continuously for more than 8 hours..

car_questions.question: When parking:
options: (1) Park facing the direction of traffic, close to the right side of the road.
(2) Park close to the left side.
(3) Park wherever convenient. On one-way roads, park close to the curb.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Park facing the direction of traffic, close to the right side of the road..

car_questions.question: When a vehicle's engine, chassis, electrical system, or doors are damaged beyond use:
options: (1) Apply to the highway supervision authority for scrapping and return the license plates.
(2) Discard the scrapped vehicle anywhere.
(3) Rent it to someone who wants to practice driving.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Apply to the highway supervision authority for scrapping and return the license plates..

car_questions.question: Children riding in a small passenger vehicle should sit in:
options: (1) The front seat.
(2) The rear seat.
(3) Either seat.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The rear seat..

car_questions.question: A driver involved in a no-injury accident whose vehicle can still be driven but fails to quickly mark vehicle positions and move to the roadside, causing traffic obstruction, shall be subject to:
options: (1) Vehicle impoundment.
(2) A fine.
(3) License plate detention.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) A fine..

car_questions.question: Traffic accidents on freeways are handled by:
options: (1) The National Highway Police Bureau.
(2) The local city/county police department.
(3) The National Police Agency Traffic Division.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) The National Highway Police Bureau..

car_questions.question: If a vehicle breaks down on a freeway or expressway:
options: (1) Coast to the shoulder and wait for assistance.
(2) Stop immediately and have passengers get out for help.
(3) Have a friend's vehicle come to tow it.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Coast to the shoulder and wait for assistance..

car_questions.question: After a traffic accident:
options: (1) If there are injuries or deaths, preserve the scene and report to police.
(2) It's not your concern; leave quickly.
(3) Argue to avoid responsibility.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) If there are injuries or deaths, preserve the scene and report to police..

car_questions.question: If you disagree with the regional review committee's accident liability determination:
options: (1) You must comply unconditionally.
(2) Apply for review by the appellate review body.
(3) File a complaint with the judiciary.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Apply for review by the appellate review body..

car_questions.question: Speeding is a primary cause of accidents. To prevent it:
options: (1) Plan your time well and leave early to avoid rushing.
(2) Reduce the engine throttle setting.
(3) Install larger brakes on the vehicle.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Plan your time well and leave early to avoid rushing..

car_questions.question: Before driving on a freeway, you should listen to radio broadcasts and use phone number:
options: (3) 1968. for road condition reports to adjust your route accordingly.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) 1968. for road condition reports to adjust your route accordingly..

car_questions.question: On a freeway or expressway:
options: (1) Only large vehicles.
(2) Only slow vehicles.
(3) Large vehicles and slow vehicles. must not occupy the inner lane to prevent other vehicles from making unsafe lane changes to overtake.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Large vehicles and slow vehicles. must not occupy the inner lane to prevent other vehicles from making unsafe lane changes to overtake..

car_questions.question: When a motorcycle is ahead of you in the same lane on a multi-lane road, you should:
options: (1) Honk to urge it into the slow lane.
(2) Directly overtake alongside it.
(3) Follow behind it or overtake from the inner lane.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Follow behind it or overtake from the inner lane..

car_questions.question: When entering a freeway or expressway:
options: (1) First use the right acceleration lane to gradually increase speed, display the left turn signal, turn your head to check the left rear, and merge into the outer lane when clear.
(2) Simply display the turn signal and merge directly.
(3) Merge directly into the outer or inner lane.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) First use the right acceleration lane to gradually increase speed, display the left turn signal, turn your head to check the left rear, and merge into the outer lane when clear..

car_questions.question: A traffic accident victim showing signs of shock will have a face that is:
options: (1) Pale.
(2) Lead-gray.
(3) Flushed.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Pale..

car_questions.question: Bright red blood spurting continuously indicates:
options: (1) Venous bleeding.
(2) Capillary bleeding.
(3) Arterial bleeding.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Arterial bleeding. | Year 115 Edition.

car_questions.question: When a vehicle catches fire after a collision, insufficient oxygen or a blocked airway can cause:
options: (1) Shock.
(2) Asphyxiation.
(3) Vomiting.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Asphyxiation..

car_questions.question: When a broken bone protrudes through the skin with heavy bleeding, you should first:
options: (1) Try to push the bone back.
(2) Stop the bleeding.
(3) Transport to a hospital.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Stop the bleeding..

car_questions.question: In the event that a large heavy motorcycle (engine displacement of 550 cc or more) traveling on an expressway cannot continue due to mechanical failure or other emergency, it shall coast out of the lane, display hazard warning lights, and be removed from the traffic lane. A breakdown warning device shall be placed behind the vehicle at a distance of:
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) 100 m.

car_questions.question: After driving through a flooded road section, you should especially:
options: (1) Test the lights.
(2) Test the clutch.
(3) Test the brakes.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Test the brakes..

car_questions.question: Which of the following is correct?
options: (1) If dashboard warning lights are on, they can be ignored and driving can continue.
(2) If the engine is smoking, continue driving until the smoking stops.
(3) If the brakes fail, immediately downshift, turn on the right turn signal, and pull over to a safe open area.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) If the brakes fail, immediately downshift, turn on the right turn signal, and pull over to a safe open area..

car_questions.question: In the event of a traffic accident with no injuries or fatalities and the vehicle remains operable, the driver shall give priority to:
options: (1) Awaiting police handling
(2) Marking the vehicle’s position and promptly moving it to the roadside
(3) Notifying the insurance company
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Marking the vehicle’s position and promptly moving it to the roadside.

car_questions.question: After marking evidence positions on the ground at an accident scene, under which circumstances should the vehicle be immediately moved to the roadside?
options: (1) Minor accidents with no casualties.
(2) There are serious injuries.
(3) There are fatalities.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Minor accidents with no casualties..

car_questions.question: Following a vehicle accident, on road sections where the maximum speed limit exceeds 50–60 km/h, a vehicle breakdown warning sign shall be placed at what distance behind the vehicle?
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) 50 m.

car_questions.question: Regarding right-of-way responsibility in traffic accidents, which is correct?
options: (1) Straight-going vehicles should yield to turning vehicles.
(2) The first to arrive at the intersection goes first.
(3) Turning vehicles should yield to straight-going vehicles.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Turning vehicles should yield to straight-going vehicles..

car_questions.question: When a traffic accident occurs, the parties should try to find at the scene:
options: (1) Friends and relatives.
(2) Eyewitnesses.
(3) Legal professionals. to help clarify the case.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Eyewitnesses..

car_questions.question: The time limit for applying for an accident liability review from the date of the accident is:
options: (1) 1 month.
(2) 3 months.
(3) 6 months.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) 6 months..

car_questions.question: For illegally driving on the highway shoulder, upon being cited on the spot, the penalty is:
options: (1) A fine.
(2) Demerit points without a fine.
(3) A fine and demerit points.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) A fine and demerit points..

car_questions.question: In the event of a traffic accident with no injuries or fatalities and the vehicle is still operable, if the driver fails to promptly mark the vehicle’s position and move it to the roadside, resulting in obstruction of traffic, the driver shall be subject to a fine of:
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) NT$600–NT$1,800.

car_questions.question: In the event of a road traffic accident, the driver or person involved shall first take appropriate measures, except for which of the following?
options: (1) If the accident occurs in a traffic lane or on the shoulder, a vehicle breakdown warning sign or other conspicuous warning device shall be placed at an appropriate distance and removed immediately after the scene is cleared.
(2) Not moving the accident vehicle or disturbing on-site evidence without authorization.
(3) Leaving the scene as quickly as possible before anyone notices.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Leaving the scene as quickly as possible before anyone notices..

car_questions.question: In a no-injury accident where vehicles can still be driven, when using photographic tools to record vehicle positions and scene evidence, which is NOT correct?
options: (1) Ensure safety during photographing and moving, and place a warning triangle.
(2) Using road markings as reference, photograph the accident vehicle and surroundings from front and rear.
(3) Prevent the other party from using recording tools to document vehicle positions and scene evidence.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Prevent the other party from using recording tools to document vehicle positions and scene evidence..

car_questions.question: In the event of a traffic accident with no injuries or fatalities, if the driver fails to take the required actions in accordance with regulations, the driver shall be subject to a fine of:
options: (3) NT$1,800–NT$5,400 A driver who flees the scene shall additionally have their driver’s license suspended for one to three months.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) NT$1,000–NT$3,000.

car_questions.question: After a no-injury accident where vehicles can still be driven, the driver should first mark vehicle positions and evidence, then move the vehicle out of traffic flow. 'Marking' methods include:
options: (1) Using photographic tools to record vehicle positions and scene evidence.
(2) Using items with marking capability to outline the four corners of a car or the two wheel positions and handlebar positions of a motorcycle on the ground.
(3) Both of the above.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Both of the above..

car_questions.question: After a traffic accident on a freeway:
options: (1) If there are injuries or deaths, preserve the scene and call 110, 1968, or use the 1968 App to request police or road management assistance.
(2) It's not your concern; leave quickly.
(3) Argue to avoid responsibility.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) If there are injuries or deaths, preserve the scene and call 110, 1968, or use the 1968 App to request police or road management assistance..

car_questions.question: After a no-injury accident on a freeway where vehicles can still be driven, the priority is:
options: (1) Wait for police to arrive.
(2) Mark vehicle positions, call 110, 1968, or use the 1968 App for assistance, and quickly move to the roadside.
(3) Notify the insurance company.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Mark vehicle positions, call 110, 1968, or use the 1968 App for assistance, and quickly move to the roadside..

car_questions.question: After a freeway traffic accident, which of the following is NOT included in the driver's initial response duties?
options: (1) If the accident is on a lane or shoulder, place warning signs at an appropriate distance; remove them after the scene is cleared.
(2) In a no-injury case or when all parties agree to move vehicles, first mark positions and evidence, then move vehicles out of traffic.
(3) Flee the scene before anyone notices.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Flee the scene before anyone notices..

car_questions.question: When driving inside a tunnel on a freeway or expressway and you cannot continue driving due to an emergency, you should first stop and wait for assistance. At how many meters behind the broken-down vehicle should you place the vehicle breakdown warning sign?
options: (1) 10 meters.
(2) 50 meters.
(3) 100 meters.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) 100 meters..

car_questions.question: What does this road sign indicate?
options: (1) Vehicle gross weight limit.
(2) Vehicle load weight limit.
(3) Vehicle empty weight.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Vehicle gross weight limit..

car_questions.question: Drivers should inspect their vehicle before driving. Based on the 'Five Fluids, Forty-six Lights, Three Waters' and tire safety standards, which of the following practices is correct and safe?
options: (1) When checking the 'Three Waters', it is sufficient to confirm only that windshield washer fluid is adequate; engine coolant and battery water do not affect driving safety.
(2) When inspecting tires, if the tread depth is found to be worn below 1.6mm (or worn to the tread wear indicator), the tires should be replaced immediately to prevent blowouts or skidding in rain.

(3) The 'Five Fluids' inspection only includes engine oil and fuel; brake fluid, transmission fluid, and power steering fluid are professional maintenance items that do not need to be checked before driving.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) When inspecting tires, if the tread depth is found to be worn below 1.6mm (or worn to the tread wear indicator), the tires should be replaced immediately to prevent blowouts or skidding in rain..

car_questions.question: Before driving, which of the following is correct for a driver?
options: (1) There is no need to check the lights when driving during the day.
(2) Relevant safety equipment must be thoroughly inspected to ensure it is functioning properly before taking to the road.
(3) Since maintenance has already been performed according to the manufacturer's prescribed time and mileage intervals, there is no need to check the engine oil, water, and tires before driving.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Relevant safety equipment must be thoroughly inspected to ensure it is | Year 115 Edition functioning properly before taking to the road..

car_questions.question: For a privately-owned passenger car using liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) or compressed natural gas (CNG) as fuel, if the year of manufacture is less than 5 years, what is the legally required periodic inspection frequency?
options: (1) Passenger cars less than 5 years old are exempt from inspection.
(2) Once every 1 year.
(3) Twice every 1 year.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Once every 1 year..

car_questions.question: Regarding the operational concepts of the 'handbrake (parking brake device)' and 'footbrake (main brake system)', which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) Both have similar structures and either one can be used interchangeably.
(2) Both can be used together when starting on an uphill slope to prevent the vehicle from rolling backward.
(3) Using both simultaneously will cause damage to the transmission.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Both can be used together when starting on an uphill slope to prevent the vehicle from rolling backward..

car_questions.question: Regarding the regulations for periodic inspections of private passenger vehicles, which of the following is correct?
options: (1) Exempt from inspection for vehicles under 5 years old; once every 2 years for vehicles 5 years or older but under 10 years; once a year for vehicles 10 years or older.
(2) Exempt from inspection for vehicles under 5 years old; at least once a year for vehicles 5 years or older but under 10 years; at least twice a year for vehicles 10 years or older.
(3) Exempt from inspection for vehicles under 5 years old; at least twice a year for vehicles 5 years or older but under 10 years.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Exempt from inspection for vehicles under 5 years old; at least once a year for vehicles 5 years or older but under 10 years; at least twice a year for vehicles 10 years or older..

car_questions.question: Which of the following statements about an oil leak in the power steering system is correct?
options: (1) The steering wheel becomes completely impossible to turn.
(2) The steering wheel can still be turned, but it will become much more difficult.
(3) It has absolutely no effect on the turning of the steering wheel.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The steering wheel can still be turned, but it will become much more difficult..

car_questions.question: If the water temperature gauge needle exceeds the upper limit while driving, what is the correct course of action?
options: (1) Safely pull over and turn off the engine, then immediately open the radiator cap to check the coolant level.
(2) Continue driving to your destination and then perform an inspection.
(3) Safely pull over and turn off the engine, then wait for the engine to cool down before checking the radiator.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Safely pull over and turn off the engine, then wait for the engine to cool down before checking the radiator..

car_questions.question: When is the most appropriate time to check the coolant level, water quality, and whether there are any leaks in the radiator?
options: (1) After the engine has cooled down (cold engine state).
(2) When the engine is at normal operating temperature, to confirm that circulation is normal.
(3) While the engine is running, so that any leaks can be observed.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) After the engine has cooled down (cold engine state)..

car_questions.question: What is the correct timing and method for checking the engine coolant level?
options: (1) Check while the engine is running.
(2) Check after the engine has cooled down.
(3) Check immediately after turning off the engine.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Check after the engine has cooled down..

car_questions.question: What is the correct way to start a computer-controlled fuel injection engine in cold weather?
options: (1) Start the engine without pressing the accelerator.
(2) Press the accelerator three times then start.
(3) Start the engine while pressing the accelerator.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Start the engine without pressing the accelerator..

car_questions.question: What liquid should be added when a car battery fluid is insufficient?
options: (1) Tap water.
(2) Distilled water or purified water.
(3) Diluted sulfuric acid solution.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Distilled water or purified water..

car_questions.question: After starting a cold engine, water dripping from the exhaust pipe usually indicates what?
options: (1) A normal phenomenon.
(2) A coolant system leak.
(3) A damaged cylinder head gasket.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) A normal phenomenon..

car_questions.question: What is the instrument on the dashboard that displays the engine rotation speed in revolutions per minute called?
options: (1) Tachometer.
(2) Speedometer.
(3) Odometer.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Tachometer..

car_questions.question: When a car is equipped with snow tires or snow chains and driving on an icy road, which of the following is the safest?
options: (1) Drive at the speed limit.
(2) Drive slowly and increase the safe following distance from the vehicle ahead.
(3) The tires will not skid so you can accelerate.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Drive slowly and increase the safe following distance from the vehicle ahead..

car_questions.question: When starting the engine of an automatic transmission vehicle, which gear position should the gear lever be in?
options: (1) D or R.
(2) P or N.
(3) Any gear position is acceptable.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) P or N..

car_questions.question: Regarding the relationship between engine operating temperature and fuel consumption, which of the following is correct?
options: (1) Lower temperature is more fuel-efficient.
(2) Lower temperature consumes more fuel.
(3) Temperature has no relation to fuel consumption.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Lower temperature consumes more fuel..

car_questions.question: Besides coolant shortage, what else may cause engine overheating?
options: (1) Fan belt breakage.
(2) Water pump failure.
(3) All of the above.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) All of the above..

car_questions.question: What is the correct timing to check the engine oil level?
options: (1) It can be checked while the engine is running.
(2) After turning off the engine and waiting a few minutes.
(3) Immediately after turning off the engine.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) After turning off the engine and waiting a few minutes..

car_questions.question: While the engine is running, what is the primary power source for the vehicle's electrical components (such as headlights and air conditioning)?
options: (1) Battery.
(2) Alternator.
(3) Ignition coil.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Alternator..

car_questions.question: When the fuel gauge needle on the car's dashboard points to 'E', what does it indicate?
options: (1) Fuel is sufficient.
(2) Fuel is extremely low.
(3) Fuel level is adequate.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Fuel is extremely low..

car_questions.question: When jump-starting a vehicle, the positive terminal of the rescue vehicle's battery (the jumper cable) should be connected to which terminal of the disabled vehicle's battery?
options: (1) Negative terminal.
(2) Positive terminal.
(3) Either is acceptable.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Positive terminal..

car_questions.question: When driving an automatic transmission vehicle down a steep slope, which of the following precautions is INCORRECT?
options: (1) Shift into a lower gear.
(2) Do not turn off the engine and coast in neutral.
(3) Vehicles going uphill must always yield to vehicles coming downhill.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Vehicles going uphill must always yield to vehicles coming downhill..

car_questions.question: Regarding the computer-controlled ABS braking system for automobiles, which of the following statements is INCORRECT?
options: (1) When the ABS warning light is on, it means the anti-lock braking function has been activated.
(2) In a computer-controlled ABS system, when emergency braking at high speed, the brake pedal will automatically vibrate up and down, which is a normal phenomenon.

car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) When the ABS warning light is on, it means the anti-lock braking function has been activated..

car_questions.question: When a car breaks down on an urban road and cannot be moved to a location that does not obstruct traffic, the driver should?
options: (1) Sound the horn to warn other vehicles.
(2) Hang a vehicle breakdown warning sign at the rear of the vehicle; a sign may also be placed at an appropriate position in front of the vehicle as needed.
(3) Open the car door to warn other vehicles.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Hang a vehicle breakdown warning sign at the rear of the vehicle; a sign may also be placed at an appropriate position in front of the vehicle as needed..

car_questions.question: During emergency braking at high speed, what device installed in the vehicle, combined with the driver calmly operating the steering wheel, may allow the vehicle to swerve around an obstacle?
options: (1) ABS Anti- lock Braking System.
(2) LDWS Lane Departure Warning System.
(3) ACC Adaptive Cruise Control System.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) ABS Anti- lock Braking System..

car_questions.question: For a licensed private passenger car (excluding those fueled by liquefied petroleum gas or compressed natural gas), which of the following correctly states the rules regarding the year of manufacture and periodic inspection requirements?
options: (1) Vehicles less than 3 years old are exempt from periodic inspection; those 3 years or older but less than 10 years must be inspected once per year; those 10 years or older must be inspected twice per year.

(2) Vehicles less than 5 years old are exempt from periodic inspection; those 5 years or older but less than 10 years must be inspected once per year; those 10 years or older must be inspected twice per year.

(3) Vehicles less than 5 years old must be inspected once per year; those 5 years or older but less than 10 years must be inspected twice per year; those 10 years or older must be inspected three times per year.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Vehicles less than 5 years old are exempt from periodic inspection; those 5 years or older but less than 10 years must be inspected once per year; those 10 years or older must be inspected twice per year..

car_questions.question: Regarding the installation of too many high-power-consuming electrical accessories in a vehicle, which of the following correctly describes the effect on fuel consumption?
options: (1) It does not affect engine fuel consumption.
(2) It reduces engine fuel consumption.
(3) It causes the engine to consume more fuel.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) It causes the engine to consume more fuel..

car_questions.question: According to Article 89 of the Road Traffic Safety Rules, which of the following is correct?
options: (1) Rear-seat passengers in small vehicles are only required to wear seatbelts on freeways and expressways.
(2) Hazard warning lights must be displayed before moving off.
(3) Before moving off, entertainment display devices within the driver's field of vision must be turned off; however, this does not apply to displays that provide driving assistance.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Before moving off, entertainment display devices within the driver's field of vision must be turned off; however, this does not apply to displays that provide driving assistance..

car_questions.question: When starting the engine of an automatic transmission vehicle, where should the gear shift lever be?
options: (1) R (Reverse).
(2) D (Drive).
(3) P (Park).
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) P (Park)..

car_questions.question: If brake fluid is spilled on a painted surface, which of the following is correct?
options: (1) Brake fluid is non- corrosive and can be ignored.
(2) Wipe it off vigorously with a cloth to dry the fluid.
(3) Rinse it off immediately with clean water.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Rinse it off immediately with clean water..

car_questions.question: When the battery is dead and the engine cannot start, which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) Both manual and automatic transmission vehicles can be push-started.
(2) Only manual transmission vehicles can be push-started.
(3) Neither manual nor automatic transmission vehicles can be push- started.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Only manual transmission vehicles can be push-started..

car_questions.question: Regarding the engine coolant temperature gauge on the dashboard, which of the following is correct?
options: (1) The temperature gauge does not change due to outside air temperature or driving conditions.
(2) The temperature gauge is affected by outside air temperature and driving conditions.
(3) The temperature gauge only changes when the engine is turned off.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The temperature gauge is affected by outside air temperature and driving conditions..

car_questions.question: What does the warning light shown in the image represent?
options: (1) Low engine oil pressure warning light.
(2) Low fuel level warning light.
(3) Engine malfunction warning light.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Low fuel level warning light..

car_questions.question: When driving a car down a long steep slope, how should the driver operate the vehicle to ensure driving safety and reduce the load on the braking system?
options: (1) Appropriately use engine braking (shift to a lower gear).
(2) Continuously lightly press the brake to maintain vehicle speed.
(3) Turn off the engine and coast down to save fuel.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Appropriately use engine braking (shift to a lower gear)..

car_questions.question: What is the icon for the charging warning light displayed on the car's instrument panel?
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1).

car_questions.question: If the battery fluid is found to be insufficient during inspection, what should be added?
options: (1) Mineral water.
(2) Sulfuric acid.
(3) Distilled water.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Distilled water..

car_questions.question: The 'engine tachometer' on the instrument panel indicates the number of revolutions per minute (RPM) of the engine. When the needle points to the '1' mark, what is the engine speed?
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) 1,000 RPM..

car_questions.question: What is this warning light?
options: (1) ABS brake warning light.
(2) Brake system warning light.
(3) Low fuel warning light.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Brake system warning light..

car_questions.question: What is this warning light?
options: (1) Low engine oil pressure warning light.
(2) Low fuel pressure warning light.
(3) Low coolant level warning light.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Low engine oil pressure warning light..

car_questions.question: When a warning light on the dashboard illuminates while driving, the driver should identify the corresponding vehicle system. Which of the following pairings is correct?
options: (1) Charging warning light corresponds to the engine combustion system; engine malfunction light corresponds to the battery charging system; brake warning light corresponds to the braking system.

(2) Charging warning light corresponds to the alternator and battery charging system; engine malfunction light corresponds to engine operation-related systems; brake warning light corresponds to the braking system.
(3) All three warning lights are uniformly controlled by the onboard computer, indicating only a general vehicle abnormality, and there is no need to distinguish individual systems.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Charging warning light corresponds to the alternator and battery charging system; engine malfunction light corresponds to engine operation-related systems; brake warning light corresponds to the braking system..

car_questions.question: For large heavy motorcycles with a total cylinder displacement of 550 cc or more traveling on freeways and expressways, the vehicle must be properly inspected. Which of the following tire tread depth conditions is not permitted during travel?
options: (1) Any point less than 1 mm.
(2) Any point less than 1.5 mm.
(3) Any point less than 1.6 mm.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Any point less than 1 mm..

car_questions.question: The 'charging warning light' on the dashboard remains continuously lit while driving. Which of the following descriptions of its meaning and response is correct?
options: (1) It indicates that electronic devices inside the vehicle are consuming too much power; turning off the air conditioning and audio system will clear the warning, and the vehicle can continue to be driven normally.
(2) It indicates that the alternator or charging system may be malfunctioning and the battery cannot be charged normally; the vehicle should be safely stopped for inspection as soon as possible.
(3) It indicates that the battery is fully charged and the system has automatically stopped charging, which is a normal condition requiring no action.

car_questions.question: Before each on-road driving practice session, regarding the confirmation of the vehicle’s safety condition, which of the following practices by the learner driver is most correct?

car_questions.question: Regarding a water-cooled engine operating without coolant, which of the following is correct?

options: (1) Since the vehicle has undergone periodic inspection according to schedule, there is no need to inspect the components before driving.

car_questions.question: When a driver notices the red battery warning light on the dashboard while driving, which of the following is the most correct action?

car_questions.question: When the red battery warning light on the dashboard illuminates while driving, which of the following statements is most correct?

car_questions.question: Which of the following is incorrect regarding how to check engine oil level in a car?

(3) 2.5 meters.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) 2.85 meters..

car_questions.question: On a freeway or expressway, the tire tread must not be worn to the:
options: (1) Any tread wear indicator as defined by CNS 1431 or CNS 4959 standards.
(2) Any point less than 1.5 mm.
(3) Any point less than 1 mm.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Any tread wear indicator as defined by CNS 1431 or CNS 4959 standards..

car_questions.question: While driving a passenger car approaching an intersection, the traffic signal turns red, and pedestrians are crossing on the zebra crossing ahead. Which of the following statements about the stopping position is most correct?
options: (1) It is sufficient as long as the front wheels have not touched the first white zebra stripe.
(2) The front edge of the vehicle should stop at least 3 meters before the zebra crossing, approximately the width of one lane or more than four zebra stripes away.
(3) Stop the vehicle between the zebra stripes of the pedestrian crossing to wait, so as to start moving as quickly as possible when the light turns green.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The front edge of the vehicle should stop at least 3 meters before the zebra crossing, approximately the width of one lane or more than four zebra stripes away..

car_questions.question: While driving through an unsignalized intersection, you notice a zebra crossing ahead and a pedestrian is stepping onto the crossing to cross the road. Which action is safest?
options: (1) The pedestrian has just stepped onto the crossing and has not yet reached the lane the vehicle is traveling in, so it is safe to maintain the current speed and pass through.
(2) Lightly honk the horn to alert the pedestrian, then accelerate through to avoid meeting on the crossing.

(3) Immediately slow down and stop at least 3 meters (approximately four zebra stripes’ width) before the pedestrian crossing, and resume driving only after the pedestrian has completely passed. Section 3 — Total: 436 questions (No. 655 ~ 1090)
