Section 3 — Total: 436 questions (No. 655 ~ 1090).

moto_questions.question: What does this road sign / hand signal indicate?
options: (1) pedestrian overpass
(2) pedestrian underpass
(3) parking area.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) pedestrian overpass.

moto_questions.question: When riding a motorcycle on a curved road, which of the following statements about safe riding practices is correct?
options: (1) Slow down sufficiently before entering the curve, and maintain a steady speed while passing through it.
(2) If you find your speed is too fast while in the curve, simply lean the motorcycle lower without slowing down.
(3) While passing through the curve, you should continuously apply the brakes lightly so you can control your speed and respond to emergencies.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Slow down sufficiently before entering the curve, and maintain a steady speed while passing through it..

moto_questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, you should always keep a safe stopping distance. Which of the following statements about judging this distance is correct?
options: (1) Maintain an appropriate distance from the vehicle ahead so that you can stop safely at any time.
(2) Keep a distance of one tire length from the vehicle ahead.
(3) Keep a distance of one vehicle length from the vehicle ahead.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Maintain an appropriate distance from the vehicle ahead so that you can stop safely at any time..

moto_questions.question: On a three-lane road in the same direction, if there are no signs or road markings specifying otherwise, how should motorcycles other than large heavy motorcycles travel?
options: (1) They should ride in the two outermost lanes.
(2) They should ride in the innermost fast lane.
(3) They may ride freely in any lane.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) They should ride in the two outermost lanes..

moto_questions.question: On a two-way, two-lane road, when there is oncoming traffic, which of the following is the correct way to overtake?
options: (1) You should accelerate to overtake.
(2) Overtaking is not allowed.
(3) Decide whether to overtake based on the type of oncoming vehicle.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Overtaking is not allowed..

moto_questions.question: When overtaking on a two-way two-lane road with lane divider markings, is the time spent in the opposing lane related to the risk of an accident?
options: (1) No relation.
(2) The longer you stay in the opposing lane, the greater the risk of an accident.
(3) The longer you stay in the opposing lane, the lower the risk of an accident.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The longer you stay in the opposing lane, the greater the risk of an accident..

moto_questions.question: On a flat, straight road, even if there is a double solid yellow line, is overtaking allowed when there is no oncoming traffic?
options: (1) Overtaking by crossing into the opposing lane is still not allowed.
(2) As long as you ensure safety, you may temporarily enter the opposing lane to overtake.
(3) Overtaking is allowed, but you must accelerate through quickly.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Overtaking by crossing into the opposing lane is still not allowed..

moto_questions.question: When a vehicle follows another vehicle, how should the rider maintain the minimum safe following distance?
options: (1) It should be greater than the stopping distance.
(2) It should be less than the stopping distance.
(3) It doesn't matter, and is unrelated to the stopping distance.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) It should be greater than the stopping distance..

moto_questions.question: Regarding measures to prevent rear-end collisions while riding a motorcycle, which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) Maintaining an appropriate safe following distance and speed is the most effective measure to prevent rear-end collisions.
(2) Always watching the brake lights of the vehicle ahead is more effective than keeping a safe distance.
(3) If the motorcycle has good braking performance, the rider may shorten the following distance to improve traffic flow efficiency.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Maintaining an appropriate safe following distance and speed is the most effective measure to prevent rear-end collisions..

moto_questions.question: While riding, a motorcycle rider should continuously check the rearview mirrors (e.g., every 5 seconds) and must not stare at the front or a single target for a long time (e.g., more than 2 seconds). This statement is:
options: (1) Correct
(2) Incorrect
(3) Only need to check the left rearview mirror.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Correct.

moto_questions.question: On a road with directional restriction lines (double solid yellow lines), regarding the rules for crossing these lines, which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) The directional restriction line prohibits vehicles from crossing; entering the opposing lane is not allowed.
(2) If the opposing lane has no oncoming vehicles and it is safe, you may temporarily cross to overtake.
(3) If the vehicle ahead in the same direction is moving slowly or stopped, you may cross into the opposing lane to go around it.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) The directional restriction line prohibits vehicles from crossing; entering the opposing lane is not allowed..

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle encounters an obstacle while riding, what is the minimum lateral safety distance that should be maintained from the obstacle?
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) 50 cm.

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle is traveling on a two-way road with lane divider markings, regarding its position on the road, which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) To make it easier for vehicles behind to overtake, the motorcycle should ride as close as possible to the right edge of the lane.
(2) The motorcycle should maintain a central position in its lane while riding.
(3) Because motorcycles are narrow, they may move left and right within the lane to stay flexible.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The motorcycle should maintain a central position in its lane while riding..

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle is traveling on a road that has separated fast and slow lanes, it should:
options: (1) Ride only in the slow lane.
(2) Ride in the outermost fast lane and the slow lane.
(3) Ride in all fast and slow lanes.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Ride in the outermost fast lane and the slow lane..

moto_questions.question: When there are no signs or markings specifying motorcycle lanes, which lane must ordinary heavy motorcycles NOT ride in?
options: (1) The outermost lane (counting from the outside).
(2) The second lane (counting from the outside).
(3) The innermost lane.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) The innermost lane..

moto_questions.question: When riding on a road without directional restriction lines or lane divider markings, and encountering oncoming traffic, which of the following driving behaviors is correct?
options: (1) If the road is wide enough for both vehicles to pass, you may maintain your speed to keep traffic flowing smoothly.
(2) Regardless of road width or conditions, you should slow down and proceed cautiously.
(3) If the oncoming vehicle has slowed down to yield, you may maintain your speed and pass first.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Regardless of road width or conditions, you should slow down and proceed cautiously..

moto_questions.question: When following a vehicle, how should the distance between your vehicle and the one in front be maintained?
options: (1) Keep a fixed distance of one vehicle length.
(2) Maintain a safe distance that allows you to stop at any time.
(3) Follow closely to avoid being overtaken by other vehicles.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Maintain a safe distance that allows you to stop at any time..

moto_questions.question: When you want to overtake the vehicle ahead, which of the following driving actions is correct?
options: (1) Overtake from the right by accelerating.
(2) Overtake from the left.
(3) Overtake from either the left or right.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Overtake from the left..

moto_questions.question: When vehicles are meeting oncoming traffic, what is the recommended minimum lateral distance between them for safety?
options: (1) At least 30 cm.
(2) At least 50 cm.
(3) Drive close to the edge of the lane.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) At least 50 cm..

moto_questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, what is the recommended minimum lateral distance to maintain from vehicles on the left and right?
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) 50 cm.

moto_questions.question: Regarding the traffic regulations for the directional separation line (double yellow lines), which of the following statements is incorrect?
options: (1) Vehicles must not cross the double solid yellow line to overtake.
(2) Vehicles must not make a U-turn on a double solid yellow line section.
(3) If the opposing lane is clear with no oncoming vehicles, you may temporarily cross the double solid yellow line to drive.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) If the opposing lane is clear with no oncoming vehicles, you may temporarily cross the double solid yellow line to drive..

moto_questions.question: On a two-way, two-lane road with double solid yellow lines, regarding overtaking rules for motorcycles, which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) If the vehicle ahead is clearly below the speed limit and obstructing traffic, you may cross the double solid yellow line to overtake.
(2) If the opposing lane is clear and you can complete the maneuver safely, you may temporarily cross the double solid yellow line to overtake.
(3) Overtaking is prohibited on double solid yellow line sections; you must not cross into the opposing lane.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Overtaking is prohibited on double solid yellow line sections; you must not cross into the opposing lane..

moto_questions.question: On a road with yellow dashed lines, when you want to overtake the vehicle ahead, you should:
options: (1) Overtake on the left side of the vehicle ahead.
(2) Overtake on the right side of the vehicle ahead.
(3) Overtake on the left or right side depending on the situation.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Overtake on the left side of the vehicle ahead..

moto_questions.question: Regarding the guidelines to avoid collisions, which of the following is appropriate?
options: (1) Regardless of speed, keep one vehicle length from the vehicle ahead.
(2) Maintain a safe following distance from the vehicle ahead.
(3) Keep the same speed as the vehicle ahead.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Maintain a safe following distance from the vehicle ahead..

moto_questions.question: Regarding safe driving distance and lane-changing concepts, which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) Following too closely, changing lanes arbitrarily, and cutting in while turning are common causes of accidents. Drivers should always maintain a safe distance and avoid arbitrary lane changes.
(2) Maintaining a safe distance mainly applies to highways and expressways; on normal city roads, because speeds are lower, the following distance can be shortened to keep traffic flowing smoothly.
(3) Skilled drivers can judge the appropriate following distance based on experience and are not bound by safe distance regulations.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Following too closely, changing lanes arbitrarily, and cutting in while turning are common causes of accidents. Drivers should always maintain a safe distance and avoid arbitrary lane changes..

moto_questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, what safe distance should be maintained from parked vehicles on the roadside to avoid sudden hazards (e.g., car doors opening)?
options: (1) Maintain a distance that allows you to stop at any time.
(2) Keep at least 1 meter (about the width of a car door) or more.
(3) Keep 50 cm or more.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Keep at least 1 meter (about the width of a car door) or more..

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle rider passes through an intersection, curve, or area with poor visibility, how should they ride?
options: (1) Slow down and proceed cautiously, paying attention to road conditions and oncoming traffic from both sides to ensure safety.
(2) Speed up to pass quickly, avoiding stopping at intersections or curves.
(3) Maintain your current speed, focus only on the forward view, and do not pay attention to side traffic.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Slow down and proceed cautiously, paying attention to road conditions and oncoming traffic from both sides to ensure safety..

moto_questions.question: On a road without lane markings, lane dividers, or directional restriction lines, what is the maximum speed a motorcycle should travel?
options: (1) No more than 30 km/h.
(2) No more than 40 km/h.
(3) No more than 50 km/h.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) No more than 30 km/h..

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle is riding in the slow lane on a road with separated fast and slow lanes, and there is no posted speed limit, what is the maximum speed allowed?
options: (1) No more than 30 km/h.
(2) No more than 40 km/h.
(3) No more than 50 km/h.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) No more than 40 km/h..

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle is traveling on a general road without posted speed limit signs or markings, what is the maximum speed?
options: (1) No more than 40 km/h.
(2) No more than 50 km/h.
(3) No more than 60 km/h.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) No more than 50 km/h..

moto_questions.question: When driving at night, lights must be used. If street lighting in urban areas is sufficient, which of the following should be used?\
options: (1) Wearing tinted glasses\
(2) Using high beam headlights\
(3) Using low beam headlights
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Using low beam headlights.

moto_questions.question: When changing lanes, to prevent danger caused by your own blind spots, you should:\
options: (1) Signal in advance, check rearview mirrors, and turn your head to look\
(2) Keep your eyes fixed on the road ahead and pay attention to traffic conditions\
(3) Maintain a safe distance from the vehicle in front
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Signal in advance, check rearview mirrors, and turn your head to look\.

moto_questions.question: When driving at night and seeing an oncoming vehicle in the distance, you should:
options: (1) use high beam headlights and honk loudly to warn the oncoming vehicle, then accelerate forward
(2) stop immediately on the spot and turn off all lights to wait for the oncoming vehicle to pass
(3) use low beam headlights and slow down to pass each other
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) use low beam headlights and slow down to pass each other.

moto_questions.question: When following another vehicle at night, the vehicle should:
options: (1) use low beam headlights
(2) use high beam headlights
(3) no need to turn on headlights
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) use low beam headlights.

moto_questions.question: When riding a motorcycle inside a tunnel:
options: (1) headlights must not be turned on
(2) headlights should be turned on and ride quickly
(3) headlights should be turned on and ride slowly
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) headlights should be turned on and ride slowly.

moto_questions.question: When the traffic light is red, and there are no pedestrians on the crosswalk, and the intersection is not congested with vehicles:
options: (1) you may proceed forward
(2) you may turn right
(3) driving is prohibited
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) driving is prohibited.

moto_questions.question: When meeting another vehicle at night, you should:
options: (1) use low beam headlights
(2) use high beam headlights
(3) no regulation
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) use low beam headlights.

moto_questions.question: When riding a motorcycle at night in a well-lit urban area,
options: (1) use low beam headlights
(2) high beam headlights may be used
(3) headlights can be turned off.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) use low beam headlights.

moto_questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a situation where motorcycle headlights should be turned on while riding?
options: (1) At night or when passing through tunnels
(2) Encountering dense fog, rain, snow, dim lighting, or poor visibility
(3) Riding on urban roads.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Riding on urban roads..

moto_questions.question: Regarding motorcycle lights,
options: (1) painting the lights is prohibited
(2) attaching tape to the lights is prohibited
(3) both of the above.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) both of the above..

moto_questions.question: Which of the following is incorrect regarding headlight usage regulations?
options: (1) Headlights must be turned on at night
(2) Headlights must be turned on when passing through tunnels or changing lanes
(3) Fog lights may be used when it is dim or visibility is poor.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Fog lights may be used when it is dim or visibility is poor..

moto_questions.question: When meeting another vehicle at night and the oncoming vehicle does not switch to low beam headlights, how should you respond?
options: (1) Retaliate by also using high beams
(2) Do not engage; reduce speed and use low beams
(3) Honk the horn to warn.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Do not engage; reduce speed and use low beams.

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle is traveling in the outermost lane and needs to enter the waiting area for turning, which is the correct way to use the turn signal?
options: (1) Turn on the right turn signal
(2) Turn on the left turn signal
(3) No need to use the turn signal
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) No need to use the turn signal.

moto_questions.question: What does this road sign / hand signal indicate?
options: (1) Turn on the headlights
(2) Pay attention to traffic signals
(3) Sound the horn
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Turn on the headlights.

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle rider approaches an intersection and intends to turn right, which of the following is the correct sequence of actions?
options: (1) Check the rearview mirror → turn on the turn signal → confirm safety → change into the outer lane, right-turn lane, or slow lane, and then turn right at the intersection.
(2) Turn on the turn signal → check the rearview mirror → confirm safety → change into the outer lane, right-turn lane, or slow lane, and then turn right at the intersection.
(3) Turn on the turn signal → change into the outer lane, right-turn lane, or slow lane, and then turn right at the intersection → check the rearview mirror → confirm safety.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Turn on the turn signal → check the rearview mirror → confirm safety → change into the outer lane, right-turn lane, or slow lane, and then turn right at the intersection..

moto_questions.question: To increase vehicle visibility, when should a motorcycle rider turn on the headlight while riding on the road?
options: (1) Only at night, in tunnels, or when visibility is poor.
(2) Only when traveling on suburban or mountainous roads.
(3) It may be turned on at all times (during the daytime, the headlight or daytime running light may be used).
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) It may be turned on at all times (during the daytime, the headlight or daytime running light may be used)..

moto_questions.question: Even during the day, when there is dense fog, how should lights be used?
options: (1) Only turn on the fog lights.
(2) Turn on both the headlight and fog lights.
(3) Only turn on the headlight.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Turn on both the headlight and fog lights..

moto_questions.question: To avoid dazzling drivers of oncoming vehicles at night, how should a motorcycle rider use the lights when meeting another vehicle?
options: (1) Use the low beam.
(2) Use the high beam.
(3) Alternately use high beam and low beam.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Use the low beam..

moto_questions.question: When riding a motorcycle at night on a road with insufficient lighting, following another vehicle, which of the following statements about light usage is correct?
options: (1) Turn on the headlight and use the low beam to recognize the road ahead while avoiding affecting the vision of the driver in front.
(2) Use the high beam to get a longer illumination range and fully see the road ahead.
(3) When following a vehicle, you can rely on the vehicle's lights; only the position lights need to be on to indicate your vehicle's location.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Turn on the headlight and use the low beam to recognize the road ahead while avoiding affecting the vision of the driver in front..

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle temporarily stops at night or on a road with poor visibility, regarding lighting display regulations, which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) If parked within streetlight illumination or at a location with reflective facilities, you may not turn on the parking lights.
(2) You must display parking lights or reflective markers to make the vehicle visible to other road users.
(3) If a vehicle breakdown sign or reflective triangle is placed, you may not turn on the parking lights.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) You must display parking lights or reflective markers to make the vehicle visible to other road users..

moto_questions.question: According to traffic regulations, apart from nighttime, when should a vehicle turn on the headlight?
options: (1) Only when passing through tunnels or culverts without lighting; if lighting is provided, headlights may be turned off.
(2) When passing through tunnels, culverts, reversible lanes, or when encountering dense fog or heavy rain that reduces visibility, headlights must be turned on.
(3) When passing through well-lit underpasses, headlights may be turned off because the environment is sufficiently bright.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) When passing through tunnels, culverts, reversible lanes, or when encountering dense fog or heavy rain that reduces visibility, headlights must be turned on..

moto_questions.question: If a motorcycle rider is stopped on-site by a police officer for not using lights according to regulations, what is the penalty?
options: (1) Only a fine
(2) A fine and demerit points
(3) Suspension of the driver's license
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) A fine and demerit points.

moto_questions.question: When a motorcycle starts moving from a parked position on the roadside, how should the rider proceed?
options: (1) Because the speed is low, there is no need to use the turn signal.
(2) Use the turn signal and pay attention to vehicles in front, behind, and on both sides, and only start moving after confirming it is safe.
(3) Using the turn signal alone is sufficient to start moving.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Use the turn signal and pay attention to vehicles in front, behind, and on both sides, and only start moving after confirming it is safe..

moto_questions.question: When riding a motorcycle at night, which of the following actions best improves driving safety?
options: (1) Turn on the high beam to get the best lighting.
(2) Wear light-colored or reflective clothing and make sure the headlights and reflectors are functioning properly.
(3) Since there are fewer vehicles at night, increase speed to shorten travel time.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Wear light-colored or reflective clothing and make sure the headlights and reflectors are functioning properly..

moto_questions.question: When starting an electric motorcycle, which of the following characteristics should the rider pay special attention to?
options: (1) Acceleration at startup is slow, so you need to twist the throttle more.
(2) Torque output is immediate and strong, so the throttle should be controlled carefully.
(3) The engine must be warmed up before starting.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Torque output is immediate and strong, so the throttle should be controlled carefully..

moto_questions.question: When riding an electric motorcycle through residential alleys, which of the following actions is the most appropriate?
options: (1) Because the vehicle is quiet, you may ride through quickly to minimize disturbance.
(2) Slow down and stay alert, because pedestrians may not notice the approaching vehicle.
(3) Continuously honk the horn to warn pedestrians.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Slow down and stay alert, because pedestrians may not notice the approaching vehicle..

moto_questions.question: According to international OECD research, when the impact speed increases from 30 km/h to 50 km/h, how does the fatality probability of a motorcycle rider change?
options: (1) It increases from 10% to approximately 40%.
(2) It increases sharply from 10% to approximately 80%.
(3) It increases from 30% to approximately 60%.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) It increases sharply from 10% to approximately 80%..

moto_questions.question: According to international OECD research, when the average driving speed increases, which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) Injury accidents and fatal accidents increase by roughly the same magnitude.
(2) The increase in fatal accidents is far greater than the increase in injury accidents.
(3) As long as the speed limit is not exceeded, the accident risk does not change significantly.
moto_questions.explanation: According to Taiwan Motorcycle Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The increase in fatal accidents is far greater than the increase in injury accidents..

moto_questions.question: [Hazard Perception Video #001] As a motorcyclist, how should you ride more safely when the vehicle on the left shows the direction light and wants to change lanes or turn?
options: (1) Pay attention to the vehicles near by and prepare to brake or slow down.
(2) Honk the horn to urge the others to yield for me to go forward.
(3) As long as I am safe, don't bother other passers-by. 4142
moto_questions.explanation: For Hazard Perception Scenario #001, Choice (1) is the correct proactive safety response.
